# Vendored adblock-lean

Source: https://github.com/lynxthecat/adblock-lean  
License: see upstream repository (GPL-compatible OpenWrt service scripts).

Files:
- `etc/init.d/adblock-lean`
- `usr/lib/adblock-lean/abl-lib.sh`
- `usr/lib/adblock-lean/abl-process.sh`

LeanDNS ships these so the appliance enables ad blocking without a separate online install.
Refresh with `scripts/sync-adblock-lean.sh`.
